findings: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from Captain Ginyu mentor Lesson 2. The projectile initially travels quickly, then slows and remains in the air for roughly three seconds; charging changes the distance at which the slowdown occurs. Current skill documentation reports a single hit, knockback, and about 10% damage. Exact charge timing and projectile-speed curve remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.
Unsupported exact frames, hidden gates, probabilities, and patch-independent scaling are not promoted.
Documented acquisition/reward conflicts remain explicit rather than normalized without evidence.
